title: Discover Boating Miami International Boat Show | February 11 – February 15
description: Join FYI Yachts at MIBS 2026. Experience the world’s greatest boat show in our home city with the local expertise of a Miami original.
html:
Every February, the world’s eyes turn to our home: Miami. As the premier Miami-based brokerage, FYI Yachts welcomes you to the most significant event on the international yachting calendar. This isn’t just another stop for us—this is our backyard, and we invite you to experience it through the eyes of the city’s true industry leaders.

From February 11 to February 15, join FYI Yachts for five days of unrivaled luxury and marine excellence. From global debuts to the most exclusive superyacht enclaves, we are here to ensure you navigate the 2026 show with the authority and insider access only a Miami original can provide.

2024 Sunseeker Ocean 90 Enclosed / Ocean 182 WORTH THE WAIT | Miami, FL

The Ultimate Miami Advantage

Navigating a show that spans from Downtown to the Beach requires more than just a map—it requires a connection. FYI Yachts serves as your local powerhouse, managing your itinerary across every venue so you can focus on the yachts that matter.

Our deep-rooted relationships with builders and designers mean our clients don’t just “see” boats—they get the first look, the private tour, and the expert negotiation that only comes from a team that lives and breathes Miami yachting.

About MIBS 2026

The 2026 show is a massive, coordinated takeover of Miami’s most iconic waterfront locations:

  • Miami Beach Convention Center: The premier destination for powerboats up to 49 feet and the latest in marine technology.
  • Pride Park: The experiential heart of the show, featuring the AquaZone and lifestyle activations.
  • Herald Plaza & Venetian Marina: Where luxury motor yachts and high-speed powerboats meet the Miami skyline.
  • Museum Park Marina: A dedicated hub for the newest sailing yachts and catamarans.
  • Superyacht Miami (Yacht Haven Grande): An exclusive, high-security enclave reserved for the largest world-class vessels.

Request Your Exclusive VIP Tour

Ready to find your next vessel in the world’s yachting capital? The FYI Yachts team is standing by to lead you through private tours of the most impressive yachts on the water.

Complete our form below to secure your VIP access and let Miami’s leading brokerage show you how the world’s greatest boat show is done in our home city.
